title: Pre-trade limits, kill switches and invariants

objectives.text: Reserve potential open-order cash and position exposure together before admitting a new command,checking exact units,bounds,existing-state consistency and aggregate invariants.

Separate disabling new risk,cancel requests and reconciled cancellation;reject unavailable or stale control inputs without pretending a pure candidate is a concurrent,durable or live risk-control system.

blocks.markdown: Risk checks belong before routing a new order,not in an after-the-fact warning that assumes cancellation will beat execution. As a scoped US securities example,SEC Rule15c3-5 concerns broker-dealers with market access and controls reasonably designed to reject orders beyond appropriate credit/capital thresholds or erroneous-order parameters. Its staff FAQ distinguishes pre-entry prevention from chase-and-cancel. This is not legal advice,a universal rule for every jurisdiction/product,or a claim our educational model meets the rule. Real thresholds require appropriate business judgment,aggregate coverage,review and supervisory ownership.

Use one currency in integer minor units and one long-only instrument. cash is current unspent cash before subtracting open BUY reservations; position is already owned units. Each open reservation(id,limit_price,remaining_qty)includes outstanding possible buys,including sent-but-unconfirmed or cancel-pending quantity when that outcome is unresolved. The own zero-fee upper-bound invariants are sum(price*qty)<=cash and position+sum(qty)<=cap. Reserving only filled quantities ignores the future exposure of working orders. Do not offset possible buys with unconfirmed sells.

blocks.title: Two individually affordable orders can breach aggregate limits

steps.text: Cash1000 minor units,position2,cap10. Existing BUY3 at100 reserves300 cash and3 possible units: available700;potential position5.
New BUY4 at100 brings cash reservation700 and potential position9,so this toy can reserve it. The candidate still has1000 unspent cash;700 is reserved,not spent. No order is sent.
Another BUY2 at100 would bring potential position11>10 and is rejected despite costing only200. Disabling new orders preserves the existing700 reservation;it does not prove those7 units cannot fill.

blocks.source:
def admit_buy(cash,position,cap,open_orders,request,enabled,age_ms):
    # Own long-only, one-instrument, one-currency, zero-fee BUY reservation model.
    for value,upper in ((cash,10**9),(position,1000),(cap,1000),(age_ms,10**6)):
        if type(value) is not int or not 0<=value<=upper:
            raise ValueError("invalid state scalar")
    if position>cap or type(enabled) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("invalid position or gate")
    if type(open_orders) is not tuple or len(open_orders)>16:
        raise ValueError("invalid bounded reservation list")
    def valid_order(order):
        return (type(order) is tuple and len(order)==3 and
                all(type(x) is int for x in order) and
                1<=order[0]<=10000 and 1<=order[1]<=10000 and 1<=order[2]<=100)
    if not all(valid_order(o) for o in open_orders) or not valid_order(request):
        raise ValueError("invalid order fields")
    ids=[o[0] for o in open_orders]
    if len(set(ids))!=len(ids) or request[0] in ids:
        raise ValueError("duplicate live reservation identity")
    reserved=sum(price*qty for _,price,qty in open_orders)
    exposure=position+sum(qty for _,_,qty in open_orders)
    if reserved>cash or exposure>cap:
        raise ValueError("inconsistent existing reservations")
    if not enabled:return "disabled",open_orders
    if age_ms>100:return "stale",open_orders
    if len(open_orders)==16:return "capacity",open_orders
    _,price,qty=request
    if exposure+qty>cap:return "position",open_orders
    if reserved+price*qty>cash:return "cash",open_orders
    return "reserved",open_orders+(request,)

original=((1,100,3),)
status,candidate=admit_buy(1000,2,10,original,(2,100,4),True,100)
print(status,candidate)
print(admit_buy(1000,2,10,candidate,(3,100,2),True,0)[0])
print(admit_buy(1000,2,10,candidate,(3,100,1),False,0))
print(original)
blocks.caption: Expected lines: reserved ((1, 100, 3), (2, 100, 4)); position; ('disabled', ((1, 100, 3), (2, 100, 4))); ((1, 100, 3),). Own exact-int bounds:cash0..1e9,position/cap0..1000,order price1..10000,qty1..100,id1..10000,<=16live reservations;age0..1e6ms with100ms inclusive fresh. Schema errors raise ValueError;control rejections return reason and same immutable reservations. No fee,short,sell,margin,FX,price-band,rate-limit or live-send implementation.

blocks.markdown: The disabled and stale results deny this new BUY only. Malformed,missing or inconsistent state raises an error and must be routed into a blocked/unavailable control state,not caught and interpreted as permission. age_ms is a supplied bounded age value,not proof of a current authenticated clock/feed. Production freshness must bind source/session and monotonic receipt timing with an explicit policy for gaps,clock jumps and unknown input. Our threshold100ms is invented for traceable exercises,not a recommended latency limit.

After a confirmed partial fill of q at execution price e<=reserved limit p,reduce unspent cash by e*q,increase position by q,and reduce that order remaining by q in one coherent update;reserved amount drops p*q. Under the zero-fee assumptions,free cash increases by(p-e)*q and position+remaining exposure is unchanged. A confirmed cancel releases only the unfilled reservation;cancel request alone releases nothing. Rejection,replace,correction,fees,FX and uncertain reconnect outcomes need explicit events/reconciliation. The function only admits reservations;it does not implement these lifecycle transitions or persist/reconcile IDs.

Define scope and acknowledgment for every kill mechanism:local new-order gate,venue session disconnect,order cancellation and account/firm-wide blocking are different actions. Keep cancel/reconcile handling available through an appropriately controlled path while blocking new risk;do not blindly route cancels through a BUY admission gate. CME Direct documents Kill my orders as your entered orders,not all company orders. No universal kill label proves every venue/order is canceled. Record what was requested,acknowledged,still working and unknown;fills that race a cancel remain real exposure.

Two workers can each read available cash700,each accept a500 reservation,and jointly over-reserve. Run validate-check-reserve in one serialized/transactional revision-checked state transition;on conflict reload and recheck rather than publishing both candidates. A pure function protects caller input and yields a candidate,but it cannot atomically publish it to concurrent senders or bind reservation+durable command intent+remote acceptance. A timeout after send requires reconciliation,not automatic release of reserved exposure. Never use this lesson as authority to send a live order.

Independent transfer: test exact-limit acceptance,one-above rejection,aggregate open orders,stale age100 versus101,disabled with existing reservations,zero cash,duplicate live IDs,malformed bools and16-slot capacity. Construct two accepted candidates from the same old state whose union breaches cash,then explain the required concurrency boundary. Add a fill/cancel reducer only after specifying its event identity,fees,source and coherent cash/position/reservation update;do not erase unknown exposure to make the invariant appear green.

Sources:[SEC market-access rule overview](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/2011/06/risk-management-controls-brokers-or-dealers-market-access),[SEC staff FAQ including Question16](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/staff-guidance/trading-markets-frequently-asked-questions/divisionsmarketregfaq-0),[CME Direct holding/killing scope](https://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information/webhelp/cme-direct/cme-direct-trader-broker/Content/HeldOrders.html),[Azure event-store optimistic concurrency discussion](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/event-sourcing). Staff FAQ is staff guidance,not a new Commission rule. All concrete model limits and gate/reason order here are own teaching policy.

summary: Aggregate possible open-order exposure matters before routing. Check and reserve together,retain unresolved/cancel-pending exposure,and distinguish blocking new commands from confirmed cancel/reconciliation. This pure zero-fee long-only candidate is not a concurrent,durable or regulatory-complete live risk engine.
